title: Ranking
description: The Studio Head's answer to a Rank now run: the rankable cards in the order they should be funded, first first, each with one reason code. Only cards the prompt marks rankable may appear; the card at position n gets rank n, and at most ten changes are applied.

reason_code.description: player_visible: a player sees it early; small_and_ready: cheap and ready to build; unblocks_others: another card needs it first; balances_the_game: it evens out the numbers; fixes_a_problem: it fixes something broken; keeps_its_place: no reason to move it.
